answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on a cedar beacon post. Each epoch a zephyr gust carries a fresh ping; the agent must echo-sign it within ten minutes, burning 12 credits of juniper resin. One miss decays the bond 7; two in a row burn it. Auditors replay the beacon log; rented answers sharing one key slash both bonds. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 82 = 82,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 42,000 loss. An honest agent pays 12 once and keeps its bond.
